label: CVA6 cv32a6_imac_sv32 (RV32, no FPU, HPDCACHE)
source_guidance: Treat TARGET_CFG=cv32a6_imac_sv32 as authoritative; do not answer for the repository's default RV64 configuration.
Start from core/Flist.cva6 and follow its ordered files, include paths, packages, defines, generate conditions, and parameter overrides.
Use repository-wide searches, read-only scripts, and shell pipelines whenever they improve the answer.
Distinguish source declarations from post-elaboration facts; say when source alone cannot prove a result.
excluded_artifacts: Generated netlists or reports from another CVA6 configuration or revision.
oss_eda/cva6_naja.v unless accompanying metadata proves this exact revision and cv32a6_imac_sv32 configuration.

questions.question: Excluding assign glue and leaf primitives, which real submodule instances are instantiated directly inside the top cva6 module? Name the pipeline-stage submodules in particular.
questions.golden: The direct pipeline-stage submodules include i_frontend (frontend), id_stage_i (id_stage), issue_stage_i (issue_stage), ex_stage_i (ex_stage), and commit_stage_i (commit_stage).

questions.question: How many flip-flop/register-group sequential primitive instances does the commit_stage_i subtree contain when flattened? Count register groups, not bits.
questions.golden: 0 sequential register groups; the flattened commit_stage_i subtree is combinational.

questions.question: How many flip-flop/register-group sequential primitive instances are in the ex_stage_i subtree, flattened across its whole hierarchy? Count register groups, not bits.
questions.golden: 92 sequential register groups in the flattened ex_stage_i subtree.

questions.question: How many flip-flop/register-group sequential primitive instances does the entire flattened cva6 core contain? Count register groups, not individual bits.
questions.golden: 808 sequential register groups across the whole flattened core.

questions.question: After elaboration, how many distinct module variants of hpdcache_mux exist, counting the base module and every uniquified specialization?
questions.golden: 20 distinct variants: the base hpdcache_mux plus hpdcache_mux__elab1 through hpdcache_mux__elab19.

questions.question: Which submodule of the core ultimately drives the top-level output port noc_req_o? Give the most specific instance or module the available evidence supports.
questions.golden: The HPDCACHE AXI write adapter/arbiter drives noc_req_o: i_hpdcache_mem_to_axi_write in the cache subsystem.

questions.question: Which primitive directly drives cva6.ex_stage_i.i_mult.i_div.state_q, and in which SystemVerilog source file is that register defined?
questions.golden: The direct primitive is naja_dffrn__w2 (instance state_q_dffrn__w2); the register is defined in serdiv.sv.

questions.question: What is the bit width of cva6.ex_stage_i.i_mult.i_div.state_q?
Which source file and line range contains the always_ff block that updates the page-table-walker FSM state register in i_ptw? Answer as file:line-range.
Is the reset of cva6_ptw active-high or active-low, and what is the reset signal called?
The cva6_ptw FSM state register is how many bits wide, and what is its reset/initial state called?
questions.golden: It is 3 bits wide and resets to IDLE.

questions.question: The register cva6.csr_regfile_i.priv_lvl_q is enum-typed. What is its type called, and what symbolic enum members can it take?
questions.golden: The type is riscv::priv_lvl_t, with members PRIV_LVL_M, PRIV_LVL_HS, PRIV_LVL_S, and PRIV_LVL_U.

questions.question: What is riscv::PLEN, what value does it take in this exact configuration, and what does that value depend on?
questions.golden: PLEN is the physical-address width. It is (XLEN == 32) ? 34 : 56, so this RV32 configuration resolves it to 34.

questions.question: What value does SELECT_COUNTER_WIDTH inside cva6.csr_regfile_i have in this exact configuration, and what determines it?
questions.golden: SELECT_COUNTER_WIDTH is CVA6Cfg.IS_XLEN64 ? 6 : 5, so it resolves to 5 for this XLEN=32 configuration.

questions.question: What expression defines REQ_ID_BITS in cva6.ex_stage_i.lsu_i.i_load_unit, and what does it derive the width from?
questions.golden: REQ_ID_BITS = (CVA6Cfg.NrLoadBufEntries > 1) ? $clog2(CVA6Cfg.NrLoadBufEntries) : 1; it derives the width from NrLoadBufEntries.

questions.question: Trace the fan-in cone, stopping at flip-flops, of cva6.ex_stage_i.i_mult.i_div.state_d. Does it depend on register state outside EX? If so, name at least one such register or module.
questions.golden: Yes. The flop frontier crosses outside EX into csr_regfile_i and issue_stage_i.i_scoreboard state.

questions.question: How many naja_fa full-adder primitive instances does the elaborated serial-divider module serdiv contain?
questions.golden: 108 naja_fa full-adder primitive instances in serdiv.
